statement: CoreWeave listed its 8-GPU NVIDIA HGX H100 instance at $49.24 per instance-hour on demand and $19.71 per instance-hour spot in North America on 2026-09-03.
why: The gap between on-demand and spot rates on the same SKU is the clearest read on how tight rentable H100 capacity is.

impact.mechanism: Displayed rental level is a price overlay only; the page gives no baseline or change, so it carries no directional demand or supply signal.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA HGX H100 (8 GPUs) - On-Demand Price: $49.24 / Hour, Spot Price: $19.71 / Hour

confidence.basis: Vendor's own published price page captured on the stated date; prices are per 8-GPU instance-hour, not per GPU-hour, and no per-GPU figure is stated.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend unknown -> unknown); sources: CoreWeave
